q1_issues.issue: The scale symbol `gain` (also at statement 7) appears nowhere in the sentence — the surface word is "up" — while the measure rule requires the surface dimension actually stated.

The closing level is stored as (Measure sk_close_1 close 8227.32 point): `close` is the verb lemma rather than a dimension, the measure hangs on the event instead of the index, and the unit `point` is carried over from the separate delta phrase where the text states no unit.

q2_gaps: a delta / change-in-value measure ("closed up 42.56 points") — Measure records an entity's level on a dimension and MoreBy compares two entities, so one entity's change across time has no licensed form and is indistinguishable here from a level
the appositive / reformulating "or" ("42.56 points, or half a percent") restating one quantity in another unit — the Disjunction and Xor sections define only the inclusive and exclusive senses
an index or price level reported by "closed at N" with no stated gradable adjective or dimension noun
